---
title: Hardening your system in the age of agents
author: Marie-Hélène Burle
---

:::{.def}

AI agents will make the coming few years interesting when it comes to cybersecurity ... whether we are talking about malicious bots unleashed on the web or about your own agents roaming your system.

It is time to think about hardening your machine and adopting better practices.

In this webinar, I will:

- explain what AI agents are and the risks they pose,
- go over basic safety rules,
- give a short demo of data encryption,
- and finally discuss and demo various approaches to agents sandboxing.

:::
